tasks.title: RecallCore package scaffold: Clock, Grade, CardSchedule
acceptance_criteria: Package builds standalone with zero SwiftData/SwiftUI imports anywhere in the target
Clock protocol + SystemClock + TestClock all present matching the locked interface signatures
Grade is Int-backed CaseIterable enum, CardSchedule is an Equatable/Sendable value type

tasks.title: SM2Engine.schedule + previewOutcomes
acceptance_criteria: Implements exact locked formula: ease floor 1.3, Again resets reps/interval and ease-=0.20, Hard is a fixed x1.2 interval multiplier (not ease-scaled) with ease-=0.15, Good is interval*ease, Easy is interval*ease*1.3 with ease+=0.15
previewOutcomes returns all four grade outcomes without mutating the input

tasks.title: RecallCoreTests: SM2Engine full suite
acceptance_criteria: Passing tests for first-review, lapse-reset, ease-floor under repeated Again
Passing test proving Hard produces a strictly smaller interval than Good from ease 2.8/interval 20
Passing spring-forward and fall-back DST transition tests using TestClock
Passing backward-clock-jump test: rewinding system time cannot make an already-graded-today card appear due again

tasks.title: DueComputation.isDue shared predicate
acceptance_criteria: Single pure function comparing calendar.startOfDay(nextReviewDate) <= calendar.startOfDay(now)
No other file in the project reimplements this comparison

tasks.title: CSVParser / CSVWriter (RFC4180)
acceptance_criteria: RFC4180-compliant quote/comma/newline handling, not naive split(separator:)
Non-UTF8 input throws a single top-level error, no fallback-encoding guessing
Files over 10,000 rows throw a plain-language over-cap error
Duplicate detection is whitespace-trimmed, case-sensitive exact match on front+back within target deck
CSVWriter emits exactly two columns (front, back); note is never included

tasks.title: RecallCoreTests: CSV edge cases
acceptance_criteria: Covers quoted commas/newlines/escaped quotes, header-only file, empty file, non-UTF8 rejection, >10,000-row rejection, duplicate-skip-with-reason, and legitimate near-duplicate (different case) preserved as distinct

tasks.title: SwiftData schema: Deck, Card, ReviewLogEntry, ModelContainer
acceptance_criteria: No @Attribute(.unique) anywhere
Every relationship Optional, every non-optional attribute has a default value (CloudKit-shape check)
Grade and isDemo stored as raw Int/Bool, never enums
Card and ReviewLogEntry both denormalize deckID/isDemo
No moveCard function exists anywhere
SchemaMigrationPlan is a minimal single-version stub

tasks.title: Theme.swift token implementation
acceptance_criteria: 4pt spacing grid s1-s10, four-tier corner radii, corrected divider hex (#E3DDD5), violet/plum demoBadge (not amber)
System Dynamic Type styles only, .monospacedDigit() on every numeral role, no custom font
No other file in the project defines a font/spacing/color literal

tasks.title: Adversarial review gate on RecallCore
acceptance_criteria: Documented line-by-line check of SM2Engine against the locked formula table, DueComputation against calendar-day semantics, and CSVParser against the adversarial case list
Any defect found is filed and fixed in RecallCore before this task closes

tasks.title: PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy + target capability lockdown
acceptance_criteria: Manifest declares zero data collection
Background Modes capability confirmed unchecked in the target
No network entitlement or URLSession usage anywhere in the app

tasks.title: DebugClockOverride (DEBUG-only)
acceptance_criteria: Parses -RecallClockOffsetDays N into an offset Clock
Wrapped entirely in #if DEBUG, verified absent from a Release build

tasks.title: GAPS.md - honest non-goal documentation
acceptance_criteria: Cloud sync, shared/community decks, and a deck marketplace each documented with a concrete note on what real implementation would require
No UI anywhere in the app implies any of these three work

tasks.title: DueQueryService
acceptance_criteria: dueCounts is one grouped FetchDescriptor per call, never one query per deck row
dueCards builds a synchronous local-array session snapshot for both .deck(_) and .allDecks scopes
In-memory ModelContainer test proves counts match a hand-constructed fixture

tasks.title: GradeRecorder
acceptance_criteria: Single call site: mutates Card via SM2Engine, inserts a ReviewLogEntry, calls context.save() synchronously
Test proves persisted Card state after record() matches SM2Engine.schedule's pure output for every grade
No other file in the project mutates Card schedule fields directly

tasks.title: SessionEngine
acceptance_criteria: Owns a captured plain-array snapshot; never wraps or re-queries via @Query
Again-graded cards are not requeued within the same session
summary() returns accurate reviewedCount/againRate/elapsed/perDeck attribution for mixed all-decks sessions

tasks.title: EntitlementGate (unlimited-only provider)
acceptance_criteria: Single EntitlementProviding protocol with UnlimitedEntitlementProvider as the only conformer this pass
No cap-check or entitlement logic exists outside this file anywhere in the app

tasks.title: NotificationScheduler
acceptance_criteria: authorizationStatus re-polled on every scenePhase == .active transition, never cached from request time
scheduleDailyReminder uses fixed generic non-numeric body text
cancelReminder verifiably removes the pending request

tasks.title: DemoDataService
acceptance_criteria: seed() creates exactly two isDemo=true decks with a backdated, non-degenerate ReviewLogEntry distribution across 30+ days
seed() guarantees at least several cards land due today (not purely historical), so entering review immediately after seeding never hits the empty state
purge() deletes every isDemo=true Deck/Card/ReviewLogEntry, verified by a zero-count fetch immediately after

tasks.title: CSVImportCoordinator
acceptance_criteria: loadPreview runs CSVParser off the main actor and returns CSVParseResult without touching ModelContext
commit is the only function that writes to ModelContext
Post-commit count reconciles exactly with preview minus errors and duplicates

tasks.title: App entry + RootTabView composition (integrator-owned)
acceptance_criteria: Three persistent tabs (Decks, Stats, Settings) only - Review is never a tab
ModelContainer and all services injected via environment
Exactly one on-screen surface computes/displays a live due-count
Tab bar items carry accessibilityIdentifiers rootTab.decksTab / rootTab.statsTab / rootTab.settingsTab

tasks.title: Decks screen
acceptance_criteria: Create/rename deck present with keyboard-fast form (deckForm.nameField, deckForm.saveButton)
Per-deck due counts come from T-013's single batched fetch, not per-row queries
Demo decks show an unmistakable diagonal DEMO stamp
Designed empty state for zero decks with a one-tap create action (decks.emptyStateCreateButton)
Deck rows and a header all-decks review action carry stable accessibilityIdentifiers (decks.firstDeckRow, decks.reviewAllButton)

tasks.title: Deck detail: card list, archive, delete, export
acceptance_criteria: DeckDetailScreen is a navigation push destination within the Decks tab, not a new top-level screen
Card add/edit with front/back/note, Tab/Return keyboard flow, no forced pointer-only interaction
Archive is reversible (deckDetail.archiveButton / deckDetail.unarchiveButton) and shown as a distinct action from permanent delete (deckDetail.deleteButton), each separately confirmed
Export uses the standard share sheet plus a confirmation toast, reachable via deckDetail.exportButton
Per-deck review entry (deckDetail.reviewButton) starts a single-deck session

tasks.title: Review flow (single-deck and all-decks)
acceptance_criteria: Presented as fullScreenCover, tab bar hidden, no interstitial screen between tap and card one
Real 3D flip under 300ms with a same-speed Reduce Motion crossfade fallback, reveal area identified as review.revealArea

Grade buttons carry review.gradeAgainButton/gradeHardButton/gradeGoodButton/gradeEasyButton identifiers and each shows a previewOutcomes-derived interval caption plus VoiceOver consequence label from the same source
Empty state text differs for 'nothing due in this deck' vs 'nothing due across all decks' with a scope-appropriate action
Demo cards visibly stamped

tasks.title: Session summary sheet
acceptance_criteria: Shows reviewed count, again-rate, elapsed time with accessibilityIdentifier summary.doneButton on its dismiss action
Shows a real per-deck breakdown when the session scope was all-decks, not just an aggregate

tasks.title: Stats screen
acceptance_criteria: Real Swift Charts views for 30-day forecast and daily history, not text stand-ins
Retention rate computed as %Good+Easy
Demo data excluded from aggregate views via an isDemo == false fetch predicate, not a post-fetch filter
Empty and sparse data render designed states, never fabricated values
No label collision at maximum Dynamic Type size

tasks.title: CSV import UI
acceptance_criteria: Import flow is file picker -> live per-row-status preview -> commit -> result, every row's status individually visible, nothing silently skipped
Post-import count reconciles exactly with preview minus flagged errors/duplicates

Not covered by the automated UI-crawl gate (system document picker is out of scope for scripted flows); correctness is proven by T-019's RecallAppTests plus manual simulator verification, documented in README

tasks.title: Settings screen
acceptance_criteria: Reminder toggle (settings.reminderToggle) reflects true OS authorization status live, never optimistic intent; denial shows a concrete re-enable path
Demo data toggle (settings.demoDataToggle) disabling shows a confirmation sheet (demoDataConfirm.confirmButton) before purge runs

tasks.title: Force-quit persistence XCUITest
acceptance_criteria: Automated test grades cards, calls XCUIApplication().terminate(), relaunches, and asserts graded cards kept their new schedule while ungraded cards remain due
Passes three consecutive clean local runs before this task is marked closed

tasks.title: Day-boundary DebugClockOverride XCUITest
acceptance_criteria: Launches with -RecallClockOffsetDays N and asserts the app's actual DueQueryService wiring reflects the new day, not just the pure module
Passes three consecutive clean local runs before this task is marked closed

tasks.title: Dark mode, accessibility, and collision pass
acceptance_criteria: Every screen verified correct in both light and dark appearance
All tap targets at least 44x44, VoiceOver announces grade consequences, no truncation or label collision at maximum Dynamic Type
Color is never the sole signal for state (e.g. demo badging, grade buttons)
Any defect found is filed against the owning primary_ui task and fixed before this task closes

tasks.title: README run instructions
acceptance_criteria: Clear steps to open and run the app in the iOS Simulator via Xcode
Documents how to run RecallCoreTests, RecallAppTests, and RecallAppUITests independently
Documents the demo-data toggle and the -RecallClockOffsetDays debug flag
Documents that CSV import is manually verified rather than covered by the automated UI-crawl gate, and why
